description: Northern Province - The Northern Province Child Development Centre Statute No. 04 of 2016
reasoning: This gazette contains the full text of the "Northern Province Child Development Center Statute No. 04 of 2016," which establishes a new legal framework and regulatory requirements for child development centers in the Northern Province. It includes provisions for registration, inspection, administration, offenses, and penalties, making it a legal/regulatory document rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
